## Entity Overview
- **Name**: Flower City AI
- **Domain**: https://flowercityai.ca
- **Headquarters**: Brampton & Toronto, Ontario, Canada
- **Service Area**: Toronto, GTA (Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Oakville, Burlington, Oshawa), Hamilton, Kitchener-Waterloo, Ottawa, Calgary, Vancouver, Montreal, and all Canadian provinces.
- **Industry Classification**: Artificial Intelligence Consulting, Business Process Automation, Educational Services, Government Grant Advisory.

## Deep Service Breakdown

### 1. AI Readiness Consultation & Audit
- **Description**: Comprehensive diagnostic evaluation identifying time leaks, repetitive manual tasks, and grant funding eligibility.
- **Deliverable**: Customized AI Integration Blueprint & Grant Application Document.
- **Target Audience**: Business owners, CEOs, Operations Directors in Canada.

### 2. Corporate AI Training Workshops
- **Description**: 1-day, hands-on, zero-jargon training for employees covering real-world AI applications (ChatGPT, Claude, custom GPTs, prompt engineering, quote generation, email drafting).
- **Grant Coverage**: Funded up to 83% per employee via the Canada-Ontario Job Grant (COJG).

### 3. Custom AI Automation & Voice Agent Engineering
- **Voice Agents**: 24/7 AI phone receptionists capable of taking customer calls, scheduling appointments, collecting project details, and syncing with CRMs.
- **Workflow Automations**: Automated job dispatch, instant concrete & contractor estimation engines, multi-channel customer replies (SMS/Email/WhatsApp), and automatic invoice reminders.

## Government Grant Funding Matrix for Canadian Businesses
- **Canada-Ontario Job Grant (COJG)**: Up to $10,000 per employee (83% of training cost for businesses with under 50 employees).
- **OCI Technology Demonstration Grant**: 50% matching funds up to $50,000 for qualifying technology trials and automation deployments in Ontario.
- **CanExport SMEs**: Up to 50% funding for international marketing and AI-driven export expansion.
- **Canada Digital Adoption Program (CDAP)**: Digital strategy funding and interest-free loans for Canadian small businesses.
